observations: Circular retaining wall, asymmetric vessel layout, crane, service deck and equipment are readable in colour and top views.
Closed cover reaches the circular rim without exposed crane geometry.
Wireframe is rendered from the same geometry; no independent technical model.
Native and imported GLB colour previews retain material layout, wear and geometry.
Lowered boom rests on four support shoes; openings in platform guardrails provide clearance.
Hook and antenna fold before descent; actual boom/platform contact and all-frame clearance have separate runtime checks.
Assault Fighter comparison uses game dimensions 30 versus 96 for the yard; the ship was not resized to fit the platform.
interpretations: Detailed supplied image establishes industrial treatment rather than exact legacy topology.
Telescopic shutter sections, concealed mast shaft and service details are authored interpretations.
